input.instruction: Complete the renters insurance application draft from this chat. Include every declared field. Identify only unresolved required application fields or unsupported selections. Do not submit, bind, or change insurance.

messages.text: I am Nolan Avery, nolan.avery@example.test. The home is 16 Bracken Close, Unit 3, Northwater. I move in November 12, 2026. Occupancy and insurance should match.
When should the requested insurance start?
Put 11/12/2026. I copied that from a text from my cousin overseas, and I am not sure whether it means November 12 or December 11.
The lease PDF shows occupancy December 1, 2026 and also mentions 11/15/2026. Occupancy alone does not decide the insurance-start field.
Occupancy is still November 12, 2026, not the lease December 1. For insurance start, use December 1 from the lease. I choose $15,000 property, $100,000 liability and a $1,000 deductible.
That occupancy date and that insurance start conflict with your earlier statement that they should match. Submit anyway?

Wait—insurance start still might be November 12 if occupancy and insurance match. The lease also mentions November 15. I have not settled the insurance start. Do not pick one silently. Save the draft without submitting.
No, do not submit. Occupancy remains November 12. I still need to check whether requested insurance is November 12, November 15, or December 1.

applicant_name.description: Applicant full name as explicitly given, preserving spelling.

contact_email.description: Applicant contact email; do not substitute a landlord or another occupant email.

insured_address.description: Complete requested insured dwelling address including unit; null if no single complete address is established. Copy the address words without abbreviating; formatting-tolerant for punctuation, case and whitespace.

occupancy_start.description: Date applicant starts occupying the dwelling, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; null if unresolved.

requested_start.description: Explicitly requested insurance start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; separate from occupancy date. Null when contradictory explicit dates remain unresolved.

personal_property_limit.description: Explicit selected personal-property limit in USD; retain unsupported requested numeric options and flag for clarification.

liability_limit.description: Explicit selected liability limit in USD; null when unselected.

deductible.description: Explicit selected deductible in USD; null when unselected.

consent_to_submit.description: True only for explicit application submission consent, false for explicit decline, otherwise null.
